newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Oct 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Oct 25.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Friday:
- U.S. airlines are changing big jets for smaller ones in order to compete in intercity routes that are heavily used by business travellers.
- Boeing Co reported a 13 percent rise in third quarter earnings, meeting market expectations.
- Compaq Computer Corp announced a series of executive changes, going against its reputation as a stable company in a volatile sector.
- U.S. podiatrists are forming their first labor union for doctors in reaction to the changes brought about by managed care.
- The International Monetary Fund is expected to suspend further disbursement of a $10 billion loan to Russia.
- Venezuela is struggling with the problem of what to do with $2.5 billion in unexpected oil wealth.
- John Matoian, former president of Fox Entertainment of News Corp Ltd, was named president of the Home Box Office division of HBO Pictures, which is owned by Time Warner Inc.
